actualAssignedTasks.prompt: Imposta «Temperatura Celsius» su 50 °C. Quale valore ottieni per «Temperatura assoluta»?
Il termometro in laboratorio indica 25 °C. Quale valore scriveresti in una legge che richiede la temperatura assoluta?

findingsAndLimits.manualProcedure: 50+273.15=323.15; 25+273.15=298.15 K. Temperature differences use equal K/°C sizes.
findingsAndLimits.sourceAssumptions: Closed fixed-mass gas; equilibrium state variables, absolute pressure and absoluteT. Celsius offset273.15 explicitly provided. Constant area; temperatures positive on full grid.

stateMeasurementScope: Exact source replay from observed controls/interaction, not private GPU-state introspection
